Hi everyone, I’m working on Morrey's Inequality..

I've discussed with @Weiyi Wang about the current gaps in polar decomposition and Jacobian. I plan to start with a prototype implementation on my branch, by using sorry and axiom for the parts that depend on their upcoming PR.

If anyone else is working on this or related Sobolev embeddings, please let me know so we can coordinate! this is my final course project, very important to me, thanks.
